title: Zoning map change for 21-31 46th Avenue, Queens
summary: This rezoning would change 21-31 46th Avenue in Long Island City from an M1-4/R6B district to an R7X district with a C2-5 commercial overlay. It would enable an 11-story mixed-use building with ground-floor retail and about 84 apartments, 21 of them income-restricted. The City Council held a public hearing on the application on September 9, 2026.
